about: K1009 (J3a, v6.1) ports, keyed by letter. entry/exit: kind (merge | fused | cusp), node (start = the first stroke's first node, end = the end of the stroke that ends at the letter's exit, fused = the body's fused junction (bk, bt) of bodies.json), stretch_u = arc-length range from that node (u; for an exit, measured back from the end), hints. Loaded by tools/gen_k1009.py (load_ports); variants override o's exit for o's B and C templates. pins: per pair, for sheets only (exit_u / entry_u). | K1009b (J3b, v6.4): copy of work21/ports_k1009.json with variants D (o's cusp exit; corners after o into i j p s u w y and at t's crossbar, level) and Dt (the same, t's crossbar by the cusp entry, tangent).
